name: Glass Tab Bar
description: A floating glass tab bar for a running app: icons that morph outline to filled, a lens that stretches as it glides, rolling badges and a raised button with an arc menu.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Four tabs ({ key, label, badge? }); the centre slot is reserved for the action button.

props.name: runnerName
props.description: Full name: first name greets, initials fill the avatars.

props.name: goalKm
props.description: Weekly distance goal for the hero ring.

props.name: week
props.description: Seven days of distance with done, today or planned state.

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to three arc-menu actions with toast copy and optional kilometres to add.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Fired when a tab is selected.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Fired when a quick action is picked.
